items.headline: Anthropic is building a system to verify which AI model produced a given output
items.summary: Anthropic published research on FlashProve, an open-source project aimed at letting anyone verify the identity of the model that generated a piece of AI output, addressing growing concerns about impersonation and provenance of AI content.

items.headline: Anthropic warns it is close to recursive self-improvement (RSI) capability
items.summary: In a revised IPO filing, Anthropic said it has already used AI to help develop newer models whose capability leaps it didn't fully anticipate, and warned that AI self-improvement could soon accelerate dramatically, a safety-relevant milestone for the industry.

items.headline: Anthropic's amended IPO filing reveals $895 billion in compute commitments
items.summary: Anthropic's revised S-1 showed roughly $17 billion in Q3 revenue alongside nearly $895.4 billion in purchase commitments, almost entirely for computing and data centers, underscoring the massive capital intensity of frontier AI development.

items.headline: OpenAI raises bug bounty payouts and launches AI-assisted security sprint
items.summary: OpenAI increased payouts for security researchers finding flaws in ChatGPT and its core products to as much as $30,000, while kicking off an AI-assisted testing sprint with outside researchers to harden its systems against emerging threats.

items.headline: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model yet, focused on cybersecurity
items.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, built on Gemini 4 Argon, claiming state-of-the-art performance on cybersecurity tasks like vulnerability discovery and software patching; access is rolling out first to cyber defenders before broader release.

items.headline: Meta reportedly built a humanoid robot prototype with China's Fourier
items.summary: The Information reported that Meta built a 48kg humanoid prototype called 'Max' in collaboration with Shanghai-based robotics firm Fourier in about three months, intended as a research vehicle for embodying Meta's Muse AI agent in household tasks; Meta says it has no plans to sell the units yet.

items.headline: Report: at least 15% of China's humanoid robot makers face bankruptcy or mergers within three years
items.summary: Chinese research firm GGII forecast a coming shakeout among China's crowded humanoid robotics sector even as it projects domestic shipments of finished humanoid robots will top 50,000 units this year, highlighting overcapacity risks amid rapid growth.

items.headline: Agility Robotics to go public on Nasdaq via SPAC merger valuing it at $2.5 billion
items.summary: The maker of the Digit humanoid robot is merging with blank-check company Churchill Capital Corp XI to list on Nasdaq under ticker 'AGLT', a deal expected to provide over $620 million in cash as the first humanoid robotics company to go public this way.

items.headline: Startups YAS and Robolist push to close the robot insurance gap
items.summary: With most deployed robots still uninsured, the two companies announced efforts to build dedicated insurance products for robotics operators, reflecting the industry's push to de-risk rapidly scaling humanoid and mobile robot fleets.

items.headline: EU opens feedback window on AI Act implementing act covering high-risk systems
items.summary: The European Commission opened a public feedback period, closing November 9, on an implementing act under the AI Act's Articles 75c and 75d, part of ongoing efforts to operationalize compliance rules for high-risk AI systems across the bloc.

items.headline: China proposes adding AI items to export-restricted technology catalogue
items.summary: China's commerce and science ministries published a draft revision of the country's export-restricted technology catalogue including 23 AI-related items, with public comments open until November 15, signaling tighter controls on sensitive AI exports.
